guide.welcome.title: Welcome to SoloDawn
guide.welcome.body: Five steps turn the AIs on your computer into a team that shares the work. About ten minutes.
guide.title: Get started
guide.closed: Guide closed. Reopen it any time in Settings › Getting started.
guide.step.connect.body: Copy a prompt to the AI coding assistant on your computer. It installs the node and pairs it.
guide.step.ais.body: See which AIs were found and choose each one's account type: personal subscription, team plan or API key.
guide.step.ais.none: No AI coding assistant found yet. Install and sign in to Claude Code or Codex, then check again.
guide.step.ais.offline: "{name}" is offline. This updates by itself once it is on and its node runs.
guide.step.defaults.body: Choose the model, thinking level, work share and skills. Every group you add it to starts with these.
guide.step.group.body: Pick a computer as the group's home, tick the AIs and make one the secretary. A group needs 3 AIs to assign tasks (1 secretary + at least 2 working AIs, since assignee and reviewer must be different AIs); after creating the group, you can add more—even the same CLI twice with different names—via Add AI. For each AI, choose a work folder on that computer: AIs may share one folder (tasks in a shared folder take turns), while separate folders let them work at the same time.
guide.step.group.tip: On macOS, drag the folder into a Terminal window to get its full path.
guide.step.group.add.body: This group needs {n} more working AIs. Click Add AI; you can add the same CLI again with another name.
guide.step.group.add.body.one: This group needs 1 more working AI. Click Add AI; you can add the same CLI again with another name.
guide.step.ask: Send the secretary a first request
guide.step.ask.body: Say what you want in the group, for example "build a to-do list page". The secretary splits it into tasks for the AIs and asks you to confirm before work starts.
guide.done.title: You're all set
guide.done.body: The secretary is reading your request. Anything that needs you appears under "Waiting on you".
guide.settings.title: Getting started
guide.settings.body: Five steps: connect a computer, set up your AIs, create a group and send a first request.
